stem_book: If block B moves towards the right with acceleration b, find the net acceleration of block A. (A slides vertically in a groove of B; the string from B's top post passes round a pulley fixed to the wall, back to a small pulley on B and down to A — see figure.) (a) 2bî + bĵ (b) bî + 2bĵ (c) bî + bĵ (d) bî − 2bĵ
work: B moves x right → both horizontal string segments lengthen by x → A rises 2x; A also moves with B: a_A = bî + 2bĵ
